note: Chase's pricing and terms for the Freedom Unlimited card: no annual fee; a purchase APR of 18.49% to 27.99% after the introductory period, set by creditworthiness, written at the top of its range, the game not knowing where in it the bank would put the holder. The 0% introductory APR for the first 15 months isn't written.

sources.title: Chase, Freedom Unlimited: Pricing and Terms (linked from https://creditcards.chase.com/cash-back-credit-cards/freedom/unlimited)
sources.said: Purchase Annual Percentage Rate (APR) 0% Intro APR for the first 15 months that your Account is open. After that, 18.49% to 27.99% , based on your creditworthiness and other factors. ... Annual Membership Fee None
